rationale: Minimal diesel dispatch maintaining battery at initial SOC of 5 MWh throughout the horizon. Each period's diesel generation exactly covers the load minus available PV, respecting generator limits (pmin=12, pmax=55). Battery remains idle as diesel is sufficient and more cost-effective than cycling with efficiency losses. Total diesel energy: 119 MWh over 4 periods × 5 minutes = 119 × (5/60) hours × $92/MWh = $912.07.
